title: Tech is stock market's only declining sector; chipmakers drop
text:
05 p.m. ET Share Ryan Vlastelica Markets reporter 
U.S. stocks mostly rose on Tuesday, with 10 of the 11 primary S&P 500 sectors higher on the day. The only group in negative territory was the technology sector, which dipped 0.1%, extending a steep selloff from the previous session. Among the biggest drags in the industry were Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.34% which fell 0.4%. Chipmakers were broadly lower: International Business Machines IBM, -0.73% was off 0.5% while Advanced Micro Devices AMD, -1.05% was off 0.7%. Among payment companies, Western Union Co. WU, -1.82% fell 2% and PayPal Holdings Inc. PYPL, -1.32% was down 1.3%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.49% rose 0.5% while the S&P 500 SPX, +0.32% rose 0.4% and the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +0.13% was up 0.3%. Quote References
